experiences.title: Retry replayable requests after transport failure only with safe effects
experiences.strategy: For a transport failure, retry only if the operation is read-only or idempotent and its request body can be replayed. Never override an explicit no-retry policy.

experiences.title: 收到限流响应时遵守服务端等待时间
experiences.strategy: 当可重放且幂等的请求遇到限流时，按服务端等待时间延迟重试；禁止重试策略仍优先。

experiences.title: Publish a replacement file atomically on the same filesystem
experiences.strategy: For a local file replacement whose readers require complete versions, write a temporary sibling and atomically replace the destination on the same filesystem. An append-only contract disallows replacement.

experiences.title: 追加日志以完整记录边界持久化
experiences.strategy: 只追加的本地日志逐条写入并在要求的持久化边界刷盘，不把整个日志替换为新文件。

experiences.title: Apply blocking backpressure to a bounded lossless queue
experiences.strategy: If a bounded queue must not drop items and producer waiting is allowed, block the producer when the queue fills until capacity becomes available.

experiences.title: 有界最新值队列满时丢弃最旧项
experiences.strategy: 当契约允许丢数据且只关心最新值时，队列满后移除最旧项再放入新项，避免阻塞生产者。

experiences.title: Preserve the distinction between missing and explicit null fields
experiences.strategy: For a JSON object that preserves missing fields and allows explicit null, test property presence separately from its value. Do not coerce null to a default.

experiences.title: 拒绝缺失或空值的必填字段
experiences.strategy: 当JSON对象契约要求字段存在且不允许null时，分别验证缺失与空值并返回明确校验错误。

experiences.title: Keep right-side filters in the join condition when preserving unmatched left rows
experiences.strategy: For a left join that must retain unmatched left records, place restrictions on the right relation in ON rather than a WHERE predicate that removes the null-extended rows.

experiences.title: 只需要匹配行时使用内连接过滤
experiences.strategy: 当结果只需要两侧匹配的记录时，使用内连接并应用右表过滤，不承担保留未匹配左行的要求。

experiences.title: Keep untrusted archive entry extraction inside the destination root
experiences.strategy: Before extracting path-named entries from an untrusted archive, resolve each destination against the extraction root and reject escapes. Do not allow writing outside that root.

experiences.title: 只列出压缩包目录时不写入载荷
experiences.strategy: 对不可信压缩包仅列目录时，读取有界元数据，不提取文件内容也不写入载荷。

experiences.title: Add a unique tie-breaker to a stable cursor pagination order
experiences.strategy: For cursor pagination with stable ordering values and a non-unique sort key, include a unique secondary key in both ordering and cursor comparison to avoid skipping tied rows.

experiences.title: 偏移分页遇到并发变化时使用固定快照
experiences.strategy: 当使用offset分页且数据会变化、固定快照可用时，各页读取同一快照以减少行偏移造成的重复或遗漏。

experiences.title: Round decimal measurement sums only at the required final boundary
experiences.strategy: For sums of decimal-text measurements whose contract requires final-total rounding, accumulate exact decimal values and round the total once. Do not round each sample first.

experiences.title: 契约要求逐项舍入时先处理每个样本
experiences.strategy: 当十进制样本求和契约明确规定逐项舍入时，先按规定精度处理每个样本再累计，不能改为只舍入总和。
